study.question: With explicit historical mask membership available at every action-channel site, is the residual click-AUC benefit of full historical action codes explained by global action composition, composition conditional on exact membership, or event alignment?
study.hypothesis: Most of the apparent action utility is accessible mask-membership information: adding membership to the blind channel raised click AUC from 0.6434778484540139 to 0.667858752166372. The matched full-plus-membership arm reached 0.6688473938657481, leaving a single-seed gap of 0.0009886416993761. A projection of per-history action counts, especially conditional on membership, may recover this residual without action-to-item or action-to-position alignment beyond the retained masks. This is a representation sufficiency hypothesis, not an established information-theoretic or causal claim.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text lines 56-97 describes target-dependent local activation and weighted history pooling. Inherit its adapted local activation; this study replaces only historical action values and tests conditional composition, without claiming a new architecture or exact original DIN reproduction.

Pinned benchmark forward lines 123-170 explicitly initializes task sequence hubs with task masks. That provides an alternative action-information route. Retain the incumbent and existing direct membership embedding, without adopting hubs or broadcasts; test composition versus alignment at fixed access sites. Original-author equivalence and local transfer effectiveness are unverified.

Pinned benchmark forward/tokenizer lines 123-175 adds item/action embeddings before unified transduction. Retain the incumbent action channel and replace its values; do not adopt sparse attention or transduction. No priority claim or effectiveness claim about UltraHSTU.

Closest local full-action control; inherit its entire code and config except the declared action replacement. Compare against its matched blind counterpart g0-r0085-membership_only, extending that contrast with projected count replacements.

inherited_components: All incumbent user/context/target/item embeddings, target-match and order moments, history compression, task routes, scorers, Dice running-state behavior, readouts, four true-label BCE losses, and custom surrogate context VJP.
Zero-initialized 16x16 exact historical membership embedding and canonical bit order is_click/cart/fav/buy from g0-r0085; original action codebook, widths, parameter order and initialization.
Frozen data identities, official_offline history construction, 100 pre-padded historical slots, unknown target action, four historical masks, single-pass host training and full validation scoring.
study.proposed_difference: Run two byte-identical reference bridges plus two standalone replacement modules. Global counts+membership replaces each valid action vector by the masked whole-history embedding mean before every scorer/summary. Conditional counts+membership instead broadcasts the FP32 action-embedding mean within each individual history and exact four-mask membership stratum. Both then add the inherited membership embedding. These are learned linear projections of normalized histograms; no new learned capacity is introduced. Item order, masks, target and padding are unchanged. The conditional mean removes within-stratum event binding but retains action distribution conditional on membership. It is not a permutation and can change representation variance and optimization.
predictions: Global counts+membership above blind+membership with a substantially smaller full-minus-count gap would provisionally support conditional utility of global action composition beyond direct membership access.

Conditional counts recovering more of the full-action result than global counts would favor membership-conditioned composition over global composition for this representation, subject to smoothing and optimization controls.

If training-only diagnostics show within-row within-stratum action variation and full actions outperform conditional means, event alignment remains a candidate explanation; a conditional permutation contrast would still be required for attribution.

Without within-row within-stratum variation, the conditional mean is algebraically identical to full action values on observed support. A tie then supplies no alignment evidence. Small floating-point/training changes cannot establish information beyond membership.
All arms should have 32192677 parameters (31793472 embedding, 399205 dense). Extra reductions may cost runtime; no parameter saving or efficiency win is predicted.
falsifiers: Global and conditional count replacements failing to improve over blind+membership undermines composition sufficiency in this architecture; it does not refute all action-frequency representations.

A material full-action advantage over both replacements after a valid nonidentity intervention undermines count sufficiency; smoothing, embedding scale, one-pass optimization and the surrogate backward remain alternative explanations.
Absent training-only heterogeneity diagnostics, or zero changed events, no alignment conclusion is admissible from the conditional mean or prior membership cycle.
Unexpected module/state/config differences outside the replacement path, altered masking/target behavior, nonfinite gradients or different parameter counts invalidate the claimed matched contrast.
alternative_explanations: Zero-initialized direct membership embeddings and pretrained-free randomly initialized action codebook rows have different one-pass optimization and exposure; the residual gap is not proof of new information.
Means shrink within-history action variation, interact nonlinearly with the scorer and Dice statistics, and redistribute gradient updates across action rows.
The action-to-membership mapping may be injective on observed support; the loader establishes action->masks but not its inverse. No action vocabulary inverse is available or assumed.
Prior cyclic permutation has a tiny click difference (-0.0000671111125154) but diagnostics were not requested; it cannot distinguish weak utility from an identity intervention.
All visible bridges reproduce exactly the same scores under the frozen seed, so they are deterministic re-executions, not independent seed evidence.
Offline delayed-feedback visibility and category/brand auxiliary-label semantics limit deployment interpretation; comparisons use only the authorized validation set.

The conditional replacement uses FP32 scatter reductions, whose CUDA accumulation order may be nondeterministic. The real host must check compatibility and numerical variation; algebraic identities do not guarantee bit-identical training.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: g0-r0085-action_plus_membership (460.47s wall, 425.35s train, 28.68s inference) and g0-r0085-membership_only (465.13s wall, 429.42s train, 28.99s inference); runtime protocol estimated_unit_seconds=481.3475877419114, trial_cap_seconds=1203.3689693547785, remaining_seconds=11942.482561588287 at entry.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Budget four complete arms, including both bridges and all failures/preflights, at approximately 2100s total with overhead; their combined per-trial caps are 4813.48s. Reserve at least 3000s beyond that for an informative follow-up or host-authorized paired seed checks. Fixed-seed bridge reruns only verify reproducibility. Do not alter frozen train_seed; any additional seed requires an authorized host protocol.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Keep at least 2400s for necessary final-suite freezing and host-owned assessment. No withheld evaluation is requested now and no withheld result enters open memory. This proposal does not perform final selection.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Do not launch training in the coding environment. Host must account for preparation, diagnostics, failures and complete jobs. Before each job recheck the ledger/deadline; launch only if its cap and attribution/assessment reserves fit. Hard deadline and trial caps prevail. Skip redundant conditional-mean training if a charged training-only preflight proves no within-row stratum variation; report the skip as uninformative, not success. If diagnostics are unavailable, label the contrast provisional and make no alignment attribution.
